trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then side missions, activities, collectibles, money and crime — and this trophy pops with the last one you need. Nothing about it can be missed; it is the final reward for finishing everything else.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.label: Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Check the tracker: when the count reads 54 of 55, one trophy remains.
Earn that last trophy and the platinum unlocks automatically.

trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, so it comes naturally at the very start of the story — just play the opening and follow the on-screen objectives until the mission ends. It can be missed only in the sense that it belongs to the story: earn it during your playthrough, and if a mission ever goes wrong, retry it from the pause menu rather than abandoning it. It is the first trophy most players will earn, and the most common one on the list at launch.

steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.

If you fail a section, retry it from the pause menu.

Chapters are story progress, so keep playing the main missions in order and do not skip ahead past them. It can be missed only if you somehow leave the chapter unfinished — complete each mission as it appears and the chapter will end on its own.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the in-game completion counter must read 100 out of 100. This is a cleanup trophy: it counts story, side missions, activities and collectibles together, so it unlocks naturally once nearly everything else is done. Use the tracker's counter to watch the percentage climb, and check the in-game stats page to see which category is still short. It cannot be missed; it can be finished any time after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.label: Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

Clear the activities and collectibles the in-game stats page still shows as incomplete.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts in total — jumps, airtime, near misses and the like, as the game counts them. The counter is cumulative across your whole playthrough, so every stunt you land while driving around adds up; it is a grind, not a skill test. Use the tracker's 0/250 counter to watch it climb, and keep playing naturally — long drives between missions will rack up plenty. It cannot be missed; it can be finished any time after the story.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.label: Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

steps: Drive fast, jump ramps and catch air whenever you travel.
Keep the stunt counter climbing across normal play.
Use the tracker counter to see how close to 250 you are.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — you only need to sample them, not master them. The official description does not name the 9 types, so check the in-game map and activities menu when you play to see what is on offer, and tick each one off in the tracker as you try it. It cannot be missed; activities stay available after the story, so mop up any types you skipped.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.label: Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

steps: Open the in-game activities list to see the 9 types on offer.
Try one of each type, even briefly.
Tick each type off in the tracker until all 9 are done.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the skill test of the list: each challenge needs a gold score, so take your time, learn the target patterns, and retry a challenge as many times as it takes — retries cost nothing but time. Use the tracker's 0/42 counter to record each gold as you earn it. It cannot be missed; the range stays open after the story.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.label: Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

steps: Visit a Shooting Range and try a challenge.
Replay each challenge until you earn gold.
Record each gold in the tracker until all 42 are done.

Use the tracker's 0/14 counter to tick locations off as you win them. It cannot be missed; the races stay available after the story.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it with your partner present — that is the condition the description sets. Pick a quiet stretch of road, lose the line of sight, and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. It cannot be missed; wanted levels can be raised any time after the story, so retry it as often as you like.

Keep your partner with you for all three robberies, and do not let the wanted level drop to zero mid-chain. It cannot be missed; shops can be robbed any time after the story, so retry the route until it clicks.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.label: Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

steps: Pick three shops close together on the map.
Rob the first with your partner beside you.
Move straight to the next two without losing the Wanted Level.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus — one activation, five takedowns, so pick a fight with a crowd and chain the kills before the effect ends. Combat Focus is a limited window, so do not waste it on a lone enemy; wait until several are close together. It cannot be missed; combat can be found any time after the story, so retry it in a busy shootout.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.label: Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

steps: Find a fight with several enemies close together.
Activate Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. The official description does not spell out the exact stunt, so check the in-game objective or map when you play: the idea is to leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned, most likely by taking a plane without going through the usual steps. It cannot be missed; the airport stays open after the story, so try it again if your first attempt fails.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.label: Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

steps: Go to VCIA, the airport.

trophies.guide: The official description is a joke, not an instruction — it names the Rhino tank and hints at heat, but gives no concrete step. From the name alone, this is almost certainly tied to driving or using a Rhino tank; check the in-game map, objectives and vehicle list when you play to find where a Rhino appears and what the game asks of it. Say it plainly: this guide cannot pin the step down from the description, so treat the Rhino as the lead and follow what the game shows you. It cannot be missed; it can be done after the story.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.label: Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

steps: Find where a Rhino tank appears in the game.
Use or drive the Rhino as the game prompts.
Follow the in-game objective until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery, so plan it quietly: enter without raising the alarm, take the goods, and leave before anyone spots you. The official description does not name the store, so check the in-game map when you play to find a jewelry store, and scope it out first. It cannot be missed; stores stay open after the story, so retry it if you are spotted.

sources.label: Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game

The PSN counter for this trophy runs to 52, so the tracker counts your progress toward that number. It cannot be missed; trucks keep running after the story.

sources.label: Guide: our own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game
